title: Feature suggestion: when holding the Meta key, indicate in the icon-only task manager the numbers for each application
line: Holding Meta now shows a number on each of the first nine task manager entries, so you can see which Meta+number opens which app.
explanation: Meta+1…9 activate the first nine task manager entries, but the task manager never showed which number belonged to which entry, so users had to count icons. KWin already reports when Meta is held to clients through the keystate protocol, which KModifierKeyInfo exposes. The task manager backend now watches Meta through KModifierKeyInfo and, after Meta has been held for the tooltip delay, the task manager that would receive the Meta+number shortcut shows a small Kirigami badge with the number on the bottom-left of each of its first nine entries; the badges disappear as soon as Meta is released.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show Meta+number hints while Meta is held

Nothing showed which entry the Meta+1…9 shortcuts would activate. When
Meta is held for a moment, the task manager that handles those shortcuts
now shows a small number badge on each of its first nine entries.

BUG: 444281

media.caption: Holding Meta on master: the task manager shows no numbers.
Holding Meta with the fix: entries 1–5 show the number of their Meta+number shortcut.
